children: HAFNIA ANNOUNCED ON WEDNESDAY IS TO OFFER ORDINARY SHARES TO RAISE USD 300 MILLION EQUIVALENT
OFFER SHARE PRICE TO BE SET VIA ACCELERATED BOOKBUILDING IN NOK
INTENDS TO USE PROCEEDS TO, AMONG OTHERS, STRENGTHEN ITS BALANCE SHEET FOLLOWING ITS ACQUISITIONS OF SHARES IN TORM
BOOKBUILDING IS EXPECTED TO CLOSE ON SEPT 24 AT 04:30 EDT / 10:30 CEST
TRADING HALT WILL BE IMPOSED THROUGHOUT THE BOOKBUILDING PERIOD AND UNTIL FINAL RESULTS
